# Recorded Roblox docs responses (test fixtures)

Recorded on 2026-10-13 from create.roblox.com and trimmed so the tests never need the network:

- `llms_excerpt.txt`: the first lines and 42 entries of `https://create.roblox.com/docs/llms.txt`.
- `search_remote_events.json`: the first six results of `/docs/api/search/how%20do%20remote%20events%20work`,
  plus one hand-added result on a foreign host (`evil.example`) that the client must drop.
- `bindable.md`: the first 40 lines of `/docs/en-us/scripting/events/bindable.md`.
